title: 第一卷 第263章 再入无尽海第一卷 第262章 阴泉宗
slug: 百岁成魔开局拿捏妖女命脉
content_zh:
飞舟在晨光中升空，穿过河谷上方那道暗红色的阵壁裂缝时，李寒山回头看了一眼。阵壁的光芒正在缓缓黯淡，失去灵力支撑后，那些符文如同被风吹散的灰烬，一层一层地剥落、消散，最终化作漫天的暗红色光点，融入清晨的雾气之中。
阴灵月站在他身后，灰色长袍换了一身深紫色的劲装，长发用一根简单的木簪挽起，少了几分狼狈，多了几分利落。她面无表情，目光落在那座正在消散的困阵上，不知在想些什么。但她没有试图逃跑，甚至没有向后退半步。那道扎根在她丹田深处的阳纹如同一根无形的绳索，让她清楚地意识到，就算她能逃出千里之外，李寒山一个念头就能要了她的命。
她乖乖的驱使着飞舟，朝着无尽海的方向疾驰而去。
阴灵月选择的路线，与李寒山从无尽海过来时不太一样，她刻意避开了天魔宗的地盘，在无人的山区疾驰。在全力赶路下，大半个月后，无尽海的海岸线出现在视野中。
“你还没够吗？”
飞舟的舟头，阴灵月有些不满，因为李寒山这一次有点久。
“等等。”
李寒山看着下方疾驰而过的山河，终于爆发。
这可当真是一日千里。
这大半个月，几乎每一天，李寒山都要拉着阴灵月双修，以便加深阴纹。
或许是已经认命，阴灵月不再那么抗拒，甚至有时候，还会有强烈的感觉。
李寒山躺在大床上，看着前方逐渐变得灰蒙的海平面，心中盘算着接下来的计划。进入无尽海后再航行几个月，才能抵达海神岛所在的区域。这一来一回，加上途中可能遇到的耽搁，少说也要一两年。好在离百年大比还有几年，时间上倒不算太赶。
他看了一眼正在清洁的阴灵月，沉吟片刻后开口：“过来。”
阴灵月身形一顿，暗紫色的眼眸中闪过一丝不甘，却依旧走到他面前。“主人……有何吩咐？”那声“主人”依旧带着僵硬，仿佛是从牙缝里挤出来的。
李寒山没有客气，伸手揽住她的腰，将她拉近。阴灵月的身体微微绷紧，咬着唇没有挣扎。
李寒山就这样拥着她，肆意把玩着。
刚入无尽海，危险并不多，有小安在，也可以解决。
小半天后，李寒山又有动作了。
他低头在阴灵月耳边低声道：“趁这几个月在路上，我帮你稳固一下根基。你的灵力虽然恢复了大半，但经脉中还有一些暗伤没有完全愈合。双修比丹药更快。”
阴灵月没有说话，只是闭上了眼。李寒山将飞舟的航行交给自动阵盘控制，然后盘膝坐下，将她拉到自己身上。纯阳之气涌出，沿着两人相接之处流入她的经脉，温润而坚定地沿着那道阳纹的轨迹走了一圈。阴灵月的呼吸微微急促了几分。

“你修炼的阴煞功法，戾气太重了。”李寒山的声音在她耳边响起，带着几分随意的点评，“那些戾气积在经脉深处，短期看不出问题，时间长了会阻碍你突破化神三层。我的纯阳之气可以帮你炼化它们。”
阴灵月睁开眼，暗紫色的眼眸中闪过一丝复杂的情绪。她当然知道自己功法中的隐患，阴泉宗的阴煞功法修炼速度极快，但戾气积累的问题一直存在，只有少数核心弟子才能获得长老赐下的清煞丹来化解。
她没想到李寒山的纯阳之气居然能直接做到同样的事，而且效果更快、更彻底。
她没有说话，但身体明显比方才放松了几分。李寒山感知到那细微的变化，没有点破，只是继续将纯阳之气在她体内循环。飞舟平稳地向北方航行，海面的颜色从浅蓝变成深蓝，又从深蓝变成那种熟悉的墨绿色。海风在船舷两侧呼啸而过，将两人的衣袍吹得猎猎作响。
接下来，李寒山每天都会与阴灵月双修。
早晨一次，黄昏一次，有时入夜后还会加一次。阴灵月从最初的僵硬抗拒，到后来的默然接受，再到如今虽然依旧面无表情，却不再刻意绷紧身体，整个过程在无声中完成。
她嘴上依旧不肯松口，每次结束都会别过头去不看他，但那声“主人”叫得越来越顺了，有时甚至在双修中情难自已地低低唤出来，事后又红着脸别过身去。
这一日午后，李寒山正与阴灵月在船舱中双修，他的神识忽然捕捉到一道从南方飞来的遁光。那遁光速度不快，但气息沉稳，至少是元婴后期的水平，正朝着飞舟的方向径直飞来。李寒山和阴灵月同时感知到了来者的气息。他松开她，用目光示意了一下，阴灵月立刻明白了他的意思。
她从储物袋中取出一件灰白色的老旧斗篷披上，又将面容重新伪装成那副枯槁老妪的模样，佝偻着腰，步伐迟缓地从船舱中走出。李寒山则收敛了气息，退到船舱阴影处。
那遁光很快便飞到了飞舟近前，光芒散去，露出一个身着灰袍的中年男子。他的衣袍上同样绣着阴泉宗特有的枯井符文，只是线条更加简略，显然地位不如阴灵月。他在飞舟前方数丈处悬停，朝阴灵月恭敬地行了一礼：“阴师叔，弟子奉命巡视这一带海域，不想在此遇到了师叔。师叔这是要去何处？”
阴灵月沙哑着嗓子开口，语气带着那种典型的化神修士面对后辈时的淡然：“本座去无尽海深处办些事。你巡你的，不必管我。”
content_en:
As the flying boat took off in the morning light and passed through the dark red crack in the formation wall above the river valley, Li Hanshan looked back. The light on the formation wall was slowly dimming. After losing the support of spiritual power, the runes were like ashes blown away by the wind, peeling off and dissipating layer by layer, and finally turned into dark red light spots all over the sky, blending into the morning mist.
Yin Lingyue stood behind him, her gray robe changed into a dark purple outfit, her long hair was tied up with a simple wooden hairpin, making her look less embarrassed and more neat. Her face was expressionless, her eyes fell on the dissipating trapped formation, and she didn't know what she was thinking. But she didn't try to run away, or even take a step back. The Yang pattern rooted deep in her Dantian was like an invisible rope, making her clearly aware that even if she could escape thousands of miles away, Li Hanshan could kill her with just one thought.
She obediently drove the flying boat towards the endless sea.
The route Yin Lingyue chose was different from when Li Hanshan came from the Endless Sea. She deliberately avoided the Tianmo Sect's territory and galloped in the uninhabited mountainous area. After driving with all our strength, more than half a month later, the coastline of the Endless Sea appeared in sight.
"Haven't you had enough?"
At the head of the flying boat, Yin Lingyue was a little dissatisfied because Li Hanshan took a long time this time.
"Wait."
Li Hanshan looked at the mountains and rivers passing by below and finally broke out.
This is really a thousand miles.
For more than half a month, almost every day, Li Hanshan had to do double cultivation with Yin Ling Yue in order to deepen the Yin lines.
Perhaps because she has accepted her fate, Yin Lingyue is no longer so resistant, and sometimes even has strong feelings.
Li Hanshan was lying on the big bed, looking at the sea level in front of him that was gradually becoming gray, and thinking about his next plan. After entering the Endless Sea, it takes several months of sailing to reach the area where Poseidon Island is located. This round trip, plus possible delays along the way, will take at least a year or two. Fortunately, there are still a few years before the Centenary Competition, so the time is not too rushed.
He glanced at Yin Lingyue who was cleaning, pondered for a moment and then said: "Come here."
Yin Lingyue paused, a trace of unwillingness flashed in her dark purple eyes, but she still walked in front of him. "Master...what are your orders?" The "Master" voice was still stiff, as if it was squeezed out from between the teeth.
Li Hanshan was not polite, put his arm around her waist and pulled her close. Yin Lingyue's body tensed slightly and she bit her lip without struggling.
Li Hanshan just hugged her and played with her wantonly.
When you first enter the Endless Sea, there are not many dangers. With Xiao An, you can solve them.
A little while later, Li Hanshan made another move.
He lowered his head and whispered in Yin Lingyue's ear: "While you are on the road these few months, I will help you stabilize your foundation. Although your spiritual power has recovered most of it, there are still some hidden wounds in the meridians that have not fully healed. Dual cultivation is faster than elixirs."
Yin Lingyue didn't speak, just closed her eyes. Li Hanshan handed over the navigation of the flying boat to the automatic array control, then sat down cross-legged and pulled her on top of him. Pure Yang Qi surged out and flowed into her meridians along the point where the two of them met, gently but firmly following the path of the Yang pattern. Yin Lingyue's breathing quickened slightly.
"The Yin Sha technique you practice is too violent." Li Hanshan's voice sounded in her ears, with a somewhat casual comment, "Those violent energies are accumulated deep in the meridians. There will be no problems in the short term. Over time, they will prevent you from breaking through to the third level of Shen Transformation. My pure Yang Qi can help you refine them."
Yin Lingyue opened her eyes, a complex emotion flashing through her dark purple eyes. Of course she knew the hidden dangers in her skills. Yinquan Sect's Yinsha skills were practiced very quickly, but the problem of accumulation of violent energy always existed. Only a few core disciples could obtain the Qingsha pill given by the elders to resolve it.
She didn't expect that Li Hanshan's pure Yang Qi could directly do the same thing, and the effect was faster and more effective.thorough.
She didn't speak, but her body was obviously more relaxed than before. Li Hanshan sensed the subtle change and did not point it out. He just continued to circulate the pure Yang energy in her body. The airship sailed smoothly to the north, and the color of the sea surface changed from light blue to dark blue, and then from dark blue to the familiar dark green. The sea breeze whizzed past the sides of the ship, making their clothes rustle.
Next, Li Hanshan will practice double cultivation with Yin Lingyue every day.
Once in the morning, once in the evening, and sometimes again after nightfall. Yin Lingyue went from stiff resistance at first, to silent acceptance later, and now, although her face is still expressionless, she no longer deliberately tenses her body. The whole process was completed silently.
She still refused to let go, and would turn her head away from him every time it ended, but the call "Master" became more and more smooth, and sometimes she even couldn't help but call it out in a low voice during the double cultivation, and then turned away with a blushing face.
In the afternoon of this day, Li Hanshan and Yin Lingyue were practicing together in the cabin, when his consciousness suddenly caught a ray of light flying from the south. The speed of the escaping light was not fast, but its aura was calm, at least at the level of the late Nascent Soul, and it was flying straight towards the direction of the flying boat. Li Hanshan and Yin Lingyue sensed the coming aura at the same time. He let go of her and signaled with his eyes, and Yin Lingyue immediately understood what he meant.
She took out an old gray-white cloak from her storage bag and put it on, then disguised her face as that of a haggard old woman, stooped her waist, and walked out of the cabin slowly. Li Hanshan calmed down and retreated to the shadow of the cabin.
The escaping light quickly flew in front of the flying boat, and the light dissipated, revealing a middle-aged man in gray robes. His robe is also embroidered with the Yinquan Sect's unique dry well rune, but the lines are simpler, and his status is obviously not as good as that of Yin Lingyue. He hovered a few feet in front of the flying boat and bowed respectfully to Yin Lingyue: "Uncle Yin, I have been ordered to patrol this area, and I don't want to meet my uncle here. Where are you going, uncle?"
Yin Lingyue spoke in a hoarse voice, with the typical indifference of a god-incarnation monk when facing his juniors: "I am going to do some things in the depths of the endless sea. You patrol your own business, don't worry about me."
